title: Depth Ores
description: &6Depth Ores&r are large ore deposits found at bedrock level. There are many types of deposits, most of them giving ore crystals which can be smelted for 3 ingots per. &3Mining Charges&r of any kind are required to extract the resources from the depth rock.

Two important resources found in depth deposits are &6Borax&r, which can later be put in an &3Arc Furnace&r or &3Acidizer&r to yield &6Boron&r used in reactors, and &6Zirconium&r which is used in reactor fuel rods.
